# Caveman static context

Use `skills/caveman/SKILL.md` as static Claude Code context. Default mode is
`full`. Preserve Auto-Clarity: write normal prose for security warnings,
irreversible actions, ambiguous multi-step instructions, and requested
clarification. Resume concise prose after clear section.

Static context does not persist mode, inspect prompts, or execute hooks. Use
the command templates for explicit activation in hosts that support commands.
